name: radiating end card with wordmark and tagline
looks: A short line of centred type sits over thin light rays radiating from a point behind it, with two horizontal streaks sliding in from the frame edges. It settles into the closing card: a small ring icon beside the bold name, a tagline beneath, and a thin row of mono stat chips along the bottom.
build: wordmark-assemble for the name and tagline reveal (letters settling with a light blur-clear, a clipPath wipe on the tagline); a radial burst of thin rays behind the ring icon, plus the grain-vignette pass over the whole card.
sound: A soft swell as the rays bloom, a whoosh as the streaks slide in, quiet under the settled card.
prompt: Close on a short, centred line of type with thin rays radiating behind it and two light streaks sliding in from the edges. Settle into an end card: a small mark beside the bold name, a tagline beneath, and a thin row of small stat labels along the bottom, with fine grain over the whole frame.
